subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Ava from <Picture 1>, a complete character sheet whose face close-up, front full-body, side full-body and back full-body panels depict the same young woman in one current state, not separate characters. She has long straight black hair with loose strands beside her face, dark brown eyes, a small beauty mark beneath her left eye, pale skin, a slender neck and build, a faint reddish scratch on her left forearm, a light gray sleeveless round-neck tank top, matching light gray slim trousers with a narrow belt and back pockets, and light gray lace-up sneakers with pale rubber soles.
<Subject 2> is the post-apocalyptic ocean environment from <Picture 2>, showing a storm-dark sea beneath heavy black-gray clouds with cold white light breaking through, a rusted ocean liner listing on the left with two red-and-black funnels, broken masts, loose rigging, a dark weathered hull and rows of windows, plus shattered small boats, splintered wooden wreckage and giant slate-blue waves crested with white foam.
<Subject 3> is the ocean infrastructure system smartphone from <Picture 3>, a multi-view sheet of one rectangular smartphone rather than separate devices: it has silver metallic edges, rounded corners, a pale silver-gray back, a black triple-lens camera module with flash, slim side buttons, slight wear near the lower edges, and a dark glass front displaying a deep-blue oceanic holographic interface with glowing cyan translucent option cards, check marks, particles, status icons, bottom controls and a circular luminous core.
<Subject 4> is the giant shark from <Picture 4>, a complete creature sheet whose front, side, rear and head-close-up panels depict the same enormous great-white-like animal in one state. It has scarred textured blue-gray upper skin, a white underside and jaw, a black eye, nostrils, gill slits, a tall triangular dorsal fin, broad pectoral fins, smaller rear fins, a crescent tail and rows of large sharp white triangular teeth in a dark open mouth.
summary:
[reference generation] Beneath the storm-wrecked post-apocalyptic sea defined by <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> is bitten and held by <Subject 4>, then a holographic countdown generated from the interface language of <Subject 3> appears; when <Subject 1> selects rebirth, the blue system light expands and engulfs the shark’s jaws.

<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - The shark’s scarred blue-gray body, white underside, black eye, fins, gill slits, snout shape and triangular teeth remain consistent as the jaws close and stay closed.
detailed_description:
Cinematic semi-realistic 3D animation with soft volumetric skin shading, fine moving hair strands, readable wet fabric folds, scarred shark skin and coherent underwater contact shadows. Ava, the shark, the interface and the storm sea share the same cold blue-gray lighting; no reference-sheet layout, repeated figures, captions or neutral display background appears.
[Shot 1] The shot continues from the prior frozen fall in a medium underwater low-angle view, with churning green-gray water between the camera and the bright broken surface. <Subject 1> is inverted near the center, long black hair streaming upward, light gray tank top and slim trousers soaked against her body, narrow belt visible, and one pale-soled sneaker hanging beyond her captured leg. <Subject 4> surges up from the lower frame and closes its blue-gray snout around Ava’s lower leg; its white jaw, black eye, gill slits, broad pectoral fins and triangular teeth are visible, and the bite remains shut with no release. A small cloud of low-saturation dark green, explicitly not red, blooms beside her calf and drifts through the water while the wound itself stays obscured. Ava’s torso goes rigid, her mouth opens in a scream, and both hands slap uselessly toward the surface. Above her, <Subject 2> appears as dark moving waves, floating splintered wreckage and the tilted rusted liner with red-and-black funnels silhouetted beneath storm clouds. The camera gives a short violent shake when the jaws meet, then abruptly stops. Synchronized sound: a heavy crushing bite, Ava’s scream, roiling water and bubbles, and a muffled heartbeat thud.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close facial shot and slowly pushes toward Ava’s eyes. <Subject 1> tilts in the water, hair fanning across her cheeks, lips trembling, small air bubbles escaping as her vision begins to blur. At the lower edge, <Subject 4> remains attached to her leg with closed jaws, its white jaw and triangular teeth partly hidden by murk. Above her, <Subject 2> remains visible only as moving dark wave shapes and cold bands of storm light. A faint silver-edged phone shape from <Subject 3> shimmers behind the projection, then the observed deep-blue system interface appears before Ava’s face as a translucent holographic window with cyan particles, glowing option-card forms, small status-style controls and a bright circular core. The display changes sequentially from "3" to "2" to "1", each number pulsing against her face.
<Subject 3> (S1), in an even electronic female system voice, spoken in en-US with lip-synchronous delivery: <d>[English] Rebirth countdown: three, two, one.</d>
Ava forces her eyes to stay on the countdown while the camera continues its slow push. Synchronized sound: precise interface ticks, a continuing muffled heartbeat, and an underwater hum that gradually becomes lower and quieter.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a near shot and holds nearly static, with <Subject 1> on the left and the hologram centered between her and the shark. Ava stares through pain, jaw clenched, bubbles escaping as she raises one trembling arm and extends a soaked fingertip toward the glowing option labeled "重生". Behind the blue light, <Subject 4> keeps its jaws closed around her leg, with teeth and white underside visible through the translucent interface.
<Subject 1> (S2), in a breathless, strained whisper, spoken in en-US with lip-synchronous delivery: <d>[English] I choose rebirth.</d>
Her fingertip reaches "重生", and a system confirmation chime sounds immediately. The circular core from <Subject 3> flares, then deep-blue panels and cyan particles expand rapidly from the center; the camera makes one short sharp shake as the interface rushes outward and engulfs the shark’s closed mouth. Ava remains at the edge of the glow with her eyes locked forward and bubbles rising as the clip ends. Synchronized sound: Ava’s gasping breath, a clear electronic confirmation tone, and a massive rising interface-expansion hum.
overall_soundscape:
Pressurized underwater ambience fills the clip with storm-surge noise filtered from above, moving currents, rising bubbles and the low presence of floating wreckage. The bite, scream, heartbeat, countdown ticks, confirmation chime and interface surge are synchronized with their visible actions. No supplied audio source is used.
